_comment: Split the 2h-timeout deepseek sweep into sequential, per-context runs. Each stays far under BENCH_MAX_RUN_SECONDS (default 7200s); the sequencer launches them one at a time so TTFT/TPS never contend. Edit the ctx32k/ctx64k targets (same URL as ctx0), then: MB_API_KEY=... python -m model_benchmarker.webapp.sequencer plans/deepseek-split.json --base-url http://<webapp>:8000

runs.name: ctx32k-light
runs._comment: 32k context WITHOUT separate_tasks: one pass per user level instead of one per task -- roughly half the wall clock of the timed-out sweep for this context.

runs.name: ctx32k-heavy
runs._comment: The saturation level alone, separate_tasks on for the clean turn1/turn2+ split. If this still approaches ~2h, drop users to 48 or requests_per_user to 3.
